name: Pipequaline
summary: Pipequaline (INN; development code PK-8165) is an anxiolytic drug that was never marketed. It possesses a novel chemical structure that is not closely related to other drugs of this type.

pharmacology.text: Pipequaline acts as a non-selective GABAA receptor partial agonist.

uses.text: Pipequaline (INN; development code PK-8165) is an anxiolytic drug that was never marketed. While its profile of anxiolytic effects without sedation would appear to have potential medical applications, pipequaline has never been developed for medical use and is currently only used in scientific research.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people, as it was never marketed. Drugs that act on the GABA-A receptor in a similar way can cause drowsiness, poor coordination and memory problems.
sideEffects.zh: 由於從未上市，人們對它在人體的作用所知甚少。以類似方式作用於 GABA-A 受體的藥物可能引起嗜睡、協調變差和記憶問題。
sideEffects.zhHans: 由于从未上市，人们对它在人体的作用所知甚少。以类似方式作用于 GABA-A 受体的药物可能引起嗜睡、协调制差和记忆问题。

fact.en: Unlike benzodiazepines, pipequaline is built around a quinoline ring with a piperidine side chain, which is where its name comes from.
fact.zh: Pipequaline 和苯二氮平類不同，它以喹啉環為骨架，並帶有哌啶側鏈，名稱就是由此而來。
fact.zhHans: Pipequaline 和苯二氮平类不同，它以喹啉环为骨架，并带有哌啶侧链，名称就是由此而来。
